Hi Luca — thanks for the quick note and the invoice. Introing Neha (Finance) and Marcus (Vendor Ops) so we can close this out.

Short answers up front:
- For a US legal entity we need a completed, signed W-9 (Taxpayer Identification Number and certification). W-8 series only applies to foreign entities.
- The W-9 should show the legal entity name that matches your EIN (Sable Diagnostics, Inc. if that is the legal name). Please also include the remit address you want on payments.
- A scanned PDF of a notarized signer affidavit (signed in the presence of a notary, then scanned) is acceptable. We do not require the physical mailing of the original in most cases.

Neha / Marcus — action items:
- Neha: confirm 1099 path for Sable given EIN once W-9 received.
- Marcus: attach vendor onboarding checklist and confirm whether the AP team needs our vendor portal entry completed or if the documents are sufficient to release payment.

Luca — if you can attach the signed W-9 and the notarized affidavit we can do verification and route the invoice for payment. I've attached our internal vendor checklist to speed things up.

Thanks,
